summary: BIP Ventures Evergreen BDC filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting that its Board of Trustees declared a cash distribution of $0.0157 per share on September 29, 2026, to shareholders of record that same date, totaling $80,256. The distribution is expected to be paid on or around October 15, 2026. No advisor, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine capital return event by the internally managed BDC; watch for future distribution declarations, NAV trends, and any changes to the distribution rate as portfolio performance evolves.
